entry.summary:
Temporary Road Closure Resurfacing Works – State Highway 2 Napier – Westshore at the roundabout with Watchman Road. Friday 2 October am, until further notice.
Due to a crash blocking the northbound lane, delays are expected along this route.
Please follow the instructions of emergency services.
